scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web "npm run dev --workspace=@staffhub/shared" "npm run start:dev --workspace=@staffhub/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@staffhub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@staffhub/shared && npm run build --workspace=@staffhub/api && npm run build --workspace=@staffhub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@staffhub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@staffhub/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@staffhub/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@staffhub/shared && npm run test --workspace=@staffhub/api && npm run test --workspace=@staffhub/web
scripts.check:construction: npm run db:validate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
